hero.title: Verify an Official Document Certificate issued from the Verification Authority
hero.subtitle: Use this service if you want to verify either a paper or electronic certificate issued by the authority.

verificationCard.heading: Please Enter the required details below
verificationCard.helpText: If you need further help email support@verification-portal.org with the certificate number and date

noticeModal.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE
noticeModal.bodyEnglish:
Dear Applicants, please visit the verification authority centers only on your scheduled appointment date and time for document processing.

Your documents will only be processed on the date of your appointment. Applicants arriving before or after the scheduled date may not be facilitated.
noticeModal.bodyRegional: محترم درخواست گزاران، برائے کرم تصدیقی دستاویزات کے لیے اپنی مقررہ تاریخ اور وقت پر تشریف لائیں۔

certificateView.issuerStatement: This apostille certificate is issued by Ministry of Foreign Affairs Pakistan.
certificateView.summaryTemplate: This apostille refers to {category} and issued on {date} and is Approved by {authority}
certificateView.disclaimerText: This apostille is not intended for use in Pakistan. It solely confirms the authenticity of the signature, seal, or stamp on the attached Pakistan public document. Please note that it does not verify the authenticity of the underlying document.
certificateView.verificationUrlText: To verify this apostille, visit www.apostille.mofa.gov.pk
